checks.title: Events per model parameter
checks.message: 1166 events, 5773 non-events, 12 parameters -> 97.2 per parameter (rule of thumb >= 10).

checks.title: Outcome missingness

checks.message: 15.5% of the analytic sample (1273) lack >=1 covariate. Multiple-imputation sensitivity analysis recommended.

checks.title: Raw values within plausible ranges
checks.message: Out-of-range values: BMXBMI (0 low, 1 high); LBXFER (0 low, 1 high); URDACT (0 low, 2 high)

checks.title: NCHS presentation standards for proportions

checks.title: Models converged without warnings
checks.message: 1 models converged cleanly.

checks.title: No implausible effect sizes
checks.message: All ratio estimates within 0.1-10 with SE(log) < 2.5.

checks.title: Model size vs design degrees of freedom
checks.message: Primary model has 13 parameters; design df = 25. Wald tests and CIs use the design df (t distribution).

checks.title: Collinearity (generalized VIF)

checks.title: Sensitivity analyses agree with primary result

race_eth <- cases(RIDRETH3 == 3, "Non-Hispanic White", RIDRETH3 == 4, "Non-Hispanic Black", RIDRETH3 %in% c(1, 2), "Hispanic", RIDRETH3 == 6, "Non-Hispanic Asian", RIDRETH3 == 7, "Other or multiracial")

egfr <- 142 * pmin(creatinine / ifelse(female == 1, 0.7, 0.9), 1)^ifelse(female == 1, -0.241, -0.302) * pmax(creatinine / ifelse(female == 1, 0.7, 0.9), 1)^(-1.2) * 0.9938^age * ifelse(female == 1, 1.012, 1)
educ <- cases(DMDEDUC2 %in% c(1, 2), "Less than high school", DMDEDUC2 == 3, "High school or GED", DMDEDUC2 == 4, "Some college", DMDEDUC2 == 5, "College graduate or above")
des <- svydesign(ids = ~SDMVPSU, strata = ~SDMVSTRA, weights = ~WT, nest = TRUE, data = <positive-weight records>)
svyciprop(~I(fid_tawfik2024 == 1), subset(des, analytic), method = 'beta')  # by sex, agecat, race_eth
svyglm(fid_tawfik2024 ~ sex + agecat + race_eth + pir_cat + bmi + inflammation + ckd, design = <full>, family = quasipoisson)
